list.name: run_id
list.label: 运行编号
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "run_id", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop, predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "joint_telemetry")
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "run_id", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop, predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "joint_telemetry")

list.name: subject
list.label: 关节/测点
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "subject", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop, predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "joint_telemetry" and r.run_id == ${run_id:json})
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "subject", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop, predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "joint_telemetry" and r.run_id == ${run_id:json})

options.content:
**选择运行与测点，再调整时间范围。**

`synthetic` 为合成演示数据；`real` 为实际采集。API导出是降采样数据，本地CSV保留原始采样。曲线无数据不代表数值为0；面板均值与图例最大值不能替代原始峰值或验收结论。当前不含停机事件标注。

panels.title: 本时间范围的数据来源
panels.description: synthetic=合成；real=实测。无行表示当前筛选没有数据。

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "joint_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == ${run_id:json})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.subject =~ /^${subject:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["source_kind"])
  |> first()
  |> keep(columns: ["source_kind"])
  |> group()
  |> unique(column: "source_kind")

panels.title: 关节温度
panels.description: 仅展示采集字段；空窗不补零或插值。缩放后为窗口均值，峰值与验收使用本地原始记录。

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "joint_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == ${run_id:json})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.subject =~ /^${subject:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_c")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
